title: PowerPoint / title-slide examples
slide_intent: Compare light and dark presentation treatments so identity can adapt to different imagery without losing recognition.
strategic_value: Shared logo placement, typography and sleeper accents can connect contrasting DB presentation covers.
demonstration: Two title-slide examples sit side by side on a gray field: one uses a light text panel and device photograph; the other uses dark text space and an employee portrait.
practical_value: Choose a light or dark cover treatment based on the image and text contrast.

content_islands.name: Paired cover slides
content_islands.spec: Place the light slide left and dark slide right with matching title hierarchy and red DB marks.

content_islands.name: Header motif
content_islands.spec: Run the red sleeper strip along the bottom of the gray surrounding field.

reference_purposes.Application: The image displays two branded presentation title slides.
